messages:
deploybot: Deploy window for release v2026.03.20-rc5 scheduled to start 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC. Canary started. HOLD triggered: auth-service 503 spikes in eu-west-1 — pausing rollout. Notifying eng-sre/eng-releases. Incident: https://incidents.example/INC-4321 :warning:
ops_lead: saw the alert, thanks. do we know if this is the new build or infra? quick check on pod restarts?
sam: looking at logs now — 5xx rate coincides with canary traffic from rc5. K8s pods started flapping after init. starting rollback to previous revision: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/auth-service --to-revision=4`
tia: +1 rollback. also recommend pinning lane to v2026.03.19 until RCA. release windows should be held for rest of today.
andy: copying calendar holders. propose new window options: 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC (preferred) or 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC. morning avoids APAC overlap.
release_manager: agree with hold. sam & ops_lead please confirm rollback status and run smoke tests. I'll update release notes and signal product. I'll also open a hotfix branch if we need an immediate patch.
sam: rollback complete — canary pods back to revision 4, no new restarts. metrics showing error rate back to baseline. running smoke: `/ci/smoke auth-service` -> PASS (3/3).
ops_lead: good. follow-up actions: (1) capture kdump and kube events for the rc5 pods, (2) flag kernel/driver logs on those hosts, (3) temp-enable fallback routing for critical customers. I'll take 1+2. tia can you coordinate fallback config with netops?
tia: will do fallback routing with netops, and I'll start drafting a short incident note for the release channel :memo:.
incident-bot: INC-4321 created by monitoring at 2026-03-20T18:02:11Z — severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.example/INC-4321
deploybot: Status update: ROLLBACK performed, ROLLOUT PAUSED per @release_manager. Current deploy status: HOLD. Tentative reschedule proposed: 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC. Owners: @sam @ops_lead @tia.
andy: calendar updated to block new window and notify stakeholders. added note to release doc: "hold due to auth-service canary 503s; rollback to rev4; tentative retry next morning".
release_manager: thanks all. actions: sam/ops_lead gather artifacts for RCA, tia coordinate fallback + release doc; I'll prepare release note language and send product/customer comms once we reconfirm healthy canary. closing thread when we have green canary + RCA outline. :white_check_mark:
